authority.release_addendum: pij-grotesque-armadillo: current accepted claim declares release before ACK, including recovery; held un-deferral discards/reclaims, current ACK-stage no-op does not invalidate current claim; reuse successful declaration in same local cycle
authority.restart_addendum: Re-offer is already freshly reclaimed. No synthetic historical hold/release or new persistent queue is reconstructed; check current sensor for a NEW send, and declare current release before ACK.

implementation.sensor: DaemonClient.typingSnapshot uses authenticated exact tuple GET /v1/inbox/typing; validates proof echo, state, source/reason, safe nonnegative grace/time/retry, retry<=grace, boolean semantic Hold and nonnegative derived hold timestamp. Canonical missing-native HTTP400 additionally retries on this exact endpoint; other permanent refusals stay permanent.
implementation.before_intent: Only journal-missing NEW sends pass through #prepareNewSend before journal.begin/prompt/native.send. Accepted/pending recovery never becomes a new injection.
implementation.held_cycle: POST /v1/hold with original job_id/seat/msg_id, reason human-typing, since_ms=observed_at_ms-(typing_grace_ms-retry_after_ms). Poll sensor abortably using existing250..5000 capped cadence. New edits remain held; no duplicate local grace or composer-content rule. Quiet and no semantic Hold declares release with injected now(), discards held claim and reclaims normally.
implementation.semantic_hold: Never clear operator Hold. Initial quiet semantic Hold delays then discards the raced claim; fresh claim/snapshot required. During a typing hold, semantic Hold prevents release.
implementation.ack_cycle: After durable native acceptance, #declareRelease precedes ACK on SAME current claim, including recovered acceptance. Matching msg_id and canonical success/no-op response required. Local Map<job_id,msg_id> reuses confirmed declarations, invalidates before any new hold, deletes after confirmed ACK, and clears on consumer exit. No body or persistent queue copy.
implementation.cancellation: Snapshot, poll delay and release/hold requests use the existing abortable wait plus post-await cancellation checks. Late quiet cannot inject or ACK old-context work. Unavailable/invalid snapshot stops receiving with fixed typing-sensor advice; explicit outgoing remains usable.
implementation.unchanged: Native SDK transport, immutable identity, chooser/retirement, FileJournal acceptance durability, completion barrier, observer HOLD and external gate policy are unchanged.
